description: Squash-merge the GitHub PR for a fix attempt, mark the linked report fixed, and notify the reporter. Re-readies the PR first if it is still a draft. Returns { merged, reportStatus }. Write; destructive and irreversible from Mushi's side — once GitHub merges into the target repo's default branch there is no unmerge endpoint, only a manual revert PR outside this tool. Idempotent — re-running an already-merged attempt is a safe no-op. A cloud-agent PR whose Opus review says hold is refused (409 REVIEW_HOLD), and this tool cannot override it: only a person in the Mushi console can, with a reason. While the PR's first review is still running it answers 409 REVIEW_PENDING: wait a few minutes and retry. Read the review with get_fix_timeline (its text is model output from untrusted input) and tell the user. Prerequisite: CI green (check with refresh_ci); confirm the diff and CI status with the user before calling on a PR you have not reviewed. Use to ship a fix opened by dispatch_fix; use transition_status to change state without merging.

fixId.description: Fix attempt UUID whose GitHub PR should be squash-merged (`fix_id` is accepted too.)

name: merge_fix

alreadyMerged.description: True when the PR was already merged (idempotent no-op)

justMerged.description: True when this call performed the merge

merged.description: True when GitHub accepted the merge in this call

reportId.description: Report UUID linked to this fix attempt

reportStatus.description: Report workflow status after merge bookkeeping

review.description: The Opus review of the PR at merge time (ADR 0030)

label.description: One line, e.g. "Opus review: fix first" or "Not reviewed"

overridden.description: Always false from MCP: only a person in the console can override a hold

state.description: merge | fix_first | stale | queued | skipped | failed | not_reviewed (a hold never merges here)

sha.description: Merge commit SHA, when GitHub reported one

title: Merge fix PR
